midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Dark page backgrounds, primary text, navigation elements, subtle borders. This deep gray creates depth and a calm, focused atmosphere

canvas-ice.$description: Canvas Ice — Light page backgrounds, secondary card surfaces, and select large UI sections. It offers a contrasting yet soft backdrop to dark text

plasma-violet.$description: Plasma Violet — Primary action buttons, prominent card backgrounds, and a key color in the brand's signature gradient. It signifies interaction and energy; Hero section backgrounds and key decorative visuals. This gradient from vibrant violet to hot pink is a signature brand element

soft-lavender.$description: Soft Lavender — Muted background for supporting cards and large content blocks, providing a gentle visual break from starker neutrals

pale-stone.$description: Pale Stone — Secondary text, muted headings, and decorative borders. A slightly darker neutral useful for de-emphasizing elements

snow-white.$description: Snow White — Card backgrounds, navigation text, and occasional text in dark sections for maximum contrast

inter.$description: The sole typeface for all text content from body paragraphs to display headlines. Its clear, modern sans-serif form maintains legibility across diverse applications, with a notable consistent negative letter-spacing for a sophisticated, tight feel.
